title: Give Oxygen a Consumer
description: Place an Air Separator in the Overworld, with an air block above and open sky. It makes 200 stored oxygen units for 16,000 base FE over 200 ticks. It needs a readable Cell and output space.

Enable Automation on the Matter Drive, connect a Mekanism Pressurized Tube, and supply oxygen to a Purification Chamber. This provides a practical consumer without a hydrogen surplus. No unused nitrogen byproduct is generated.
